agent_assessment: The vrooli-events scenario is fully implemented and production-grade. All 15 Go packages build cleanly. All tests pass across every package (api, broker, config, convert, emitter, fallback, headers, match, middleware, policy, resolver, sqlutil, store, subscription, testutil). The two issues flagged in round 1 are resolved: (1) CLI now uses cli-core ScenarioApp with proper ecosystem integration, and (2) glob matching is consolidated in internal/match/ with no duplication. Implementation matches the plan specification precisely: SQLite WAL-mode event store with exact schema from Finding 14 including store_meta tracking, SSE pub/sub broker with 64-capacity buffered channels and 30s heartbeat with dropped_count reporting, HTTP ingestion returning 202 Accepted with async broadcast, Go 1.22+ net/http ServeMux routing (no external router), Last-Event-ID resume support, dual-trigger pruning (30-day + size-based via configurable thresholds), graceful shutdown via context cancellation cascade, and proto binary storage with protojson wire format. The implementation also includes additional capabilities beyond the core plan scope: policy engine (CRUD, evaluation, violation tracking, circuit breakers), persistent subscriptions with webhook delivery, and an emitter/resolver layer. One minor formatting issue: internal/store/pruner_test.go needs gofumpt formatting. service.json is well-configured with proper lifecycle steps.
notes: internal/store/pruner_test.go has a gofumpt formatting issue (only file flagged by gofumpt -l). Trivial fix: run gofumpt -w on the file.

Implementation scope exceeds plan: includes policy engine, persistent subscriptions with webhook delivery, middleware, emitter, resolver, and fallback packages. These are listed as out-of-scope in the plan (Section 3) but appear to be forward work from subsequent backlog items. Not a problem, but worth noting for scope tracking.
Round 1 issues are fully resolved: CLI uses cli-core ScenarioApp, glob matching consolidated in internal/match/.
Build artifacts (compiled binaries) are checked into the repo at api/vrooli-events-api, api/api, cli/cli, cli/vrooli-events. These should likely be gitignored.

evidence.title: go build ./... — All packages compile
evidence.description: Full Go build of all packages succeeds with zero errors. 15 packages compile cleanly.

test_results.name: go build ./...
test_results.output_summary: Clean build, no errors or warnings

evidence.title: go test ./... — All 15 packages pass
evidence.description: Complete test suite passes across all packages. Store tests take ~6.5s (real SQLite integration tests), all others under 300ms. Total test time ~7.2s.

evidence.title: gofumpt -l — Formatting check
evidence.description: gofumpt reports only one file with formatting issues: internal/store/pruner_test.go. All other files are properly formatted.

evidence.title: SQLite schema matches plan Finding 14
evidence.description: Verified sqlite.go schema DDL matches plan Section 9 exactly: events table with all columns (id, event_id, source_scenario, target_scenario, event_type, correlation_id, payload BLOB, metadata TEXT, created_at), all 4 indexes (type, source, correlation with partial index, created_at), store_meta table with total_payload_bytes tracking. WAL mode pragmas present (journal_mode=WAL, busy_timeout=10000, synchronous=NORMAL).

evidence.title: HTTP routing matches plan — stdlib ServeMux, correct methods and paths
evidence.description: routes.go uses Go 1.22+ net/http.ServeMux with method routing: POST /api/v1/events (ingest), GET /api/v1/events (query), GET /api/v1/events/subscribe (SSE), GET /health. No external router dependency. Additional policy and subscription endpoints also registered.

evidence.title: SSE broker implements all plan requirements
evidence.description: broker.go verified: 64-capacity buffered channels (configurable), 30s heartbeat with dropped_count reporting, non-blocking fan-out with drop+notify backpressure, segment-aware glob matching via internal/match package, context-based shutdown with subscriber cleanup. Last-Event-ID resume implemented in handlers.go via replayMissedEvents().

evidence.title: Ingestion handler returns 202 Accepted with async broadcast
evidence.description: handleIngest in handlers.go: validates envelope, converts to store.Event, inserts synchronously, then broadcasts via goroutine (async), returns 202 Accepted with {id, eventId}. Matches plan's 'sync store, async broadcast' decision.

evidence.title: Dual-trigger pruning with configurable intervals
evidence.description: pruner.go implements background goroutine with configurable interval (default 6h), delegates to store.Prune() which handles both time-based (MaxAge, default 30 days) and size-based (MaxSizeBytes) deletion. Context-aware for graceful shutdown.

evidence.title: CLI uses cli-core ScenarioApp (round 1 fix verified)
evidence.description: cli/app.go imports github.com/vrooli/cli-core/cliapp and github.com/vrooli/cli-core/cliutil. NewApp() creates cliapp.ScenarioApp with proper ecosystem configuration. Commands registered: ingest, query, subscribe, stats, status, configure. Round 1 issue fully resolved.

evidence.title: Glob matching consolidated (round 1 fix verified)
evidence.description: Glob matching now lives in internal/match/match.go as a shared package. broker/matcher.go delegates to match.Glob(). No duplicated matchGlob/matchSegments functions found anywhere in the codebase. Round 1 issue fully resolved.

evidence.title: Proto conversion layer implemented
evidence.description: internal/convert/convert.go provides EnvelopeToEvent and EventToEnvelope functions converting between internal store.Event and proto domain.EventEnvelope. Uses proto.Marshal/Unmarshal for Any payload, timestamppb for timestamps. Graceful handling of invalid payload bytes (drops rather than errors).

evidence.title: Graceful shutdown cascade
evidence.description: main.go implements context cancellation cascade: root context cancel → server.Run Cleanup callback → broker.Close() → store.Close(). Uses api-core/server.Run with WriteTimeout=0 for SSE compatibility. Matches plan's settled decision on graceful shutdown.
